name: create-riot-app
description: Riot.js application starter. A create-react-app style CLI (bun create) and a demo with a drawer, sounds, and screens.

scripts.lint: biome check bin && bun run --cwd template lint
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write bin && bun run --cwd template lint:fix
scripts.format: biome format --write bin && bun run --cwd template format
scripts.format:check: biome format bin && bun run --cwd template format:check
